items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: she happened to be out there... I invited them to have a drink... I took her home

ctx.x: At the Stork Club. In those days, the Conga was very popular, especially for the higher-up people. So I borrowed a conga from one of my musicians and I went up there and make a conga line and collect about thirty-thousand dollars, So I - he gave me a hundred dollars. In those days one hundred dollars was a lot of money. - so I got my conga and come back to the Park Plaza and she happened to be out there - because she was accompanying a friend that the mother wouldn't allow her to go places that wasn't accompanied…

For her was a surprise. She knows the other musicians - because, you know, since she was a kid - but me!, drinking Coca-Cola? Well, she say, this fellow look like a clean-cut fellow; so it come to my mind to say to her: You know? I am looking for a job, and she said: "Well, I know a man that might get you a job. See me tomorrow, six-thirty or seven o'clock in the evening, 116th St. and 7th Ave., and I will take you to the place that you could get a job."
